t: (PDF) HealthNode: Software Framework for Efficiently Designing and Developing Cloud-Based Healthcare Applications
s: April 19, 2018 - Although appealing, however, prototyping and validating the feasibility of an application-level idea is yet challenging without a solid understanding of the cloud, mobile, and the interconnectivity infrastructure. In this paper, we provide a solution to this by proposing a framework called HealthNode, which is a general-purpose framework for developing healthcare applications on cloud platforms using Node.js.
